4.3.1.11.1.1 Primitive Data Types
[SWS_Rte_04505]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00091
⌈The RTE shall use the Com Symbolic Name (See [TPS_ECUC_02108]) of the corre-
sponding ComSignal when invoking the COM API for signal.⌋
The actual Com Symbolic Name has to be gathered from the ECU configuration of the
COM module. The Com Symbolic Name is used to establish the link between the
ComSignal of the COM module’s configuration and the corresponding ISignal of
the System Template.
